path.title: in_set → assess (data): reads rir, effort, feel, technique, rom, type · field rir
in_set → objective (data): reads weightKg, reps, restSecBefore · field reps
in_settings → analyze (data): the quality model (credits, numbers check) · field quality
in_workout → sessionend (data): last ticked set, else end time, start + duration, start, 18:00 · field endTime
in_body → weighins (data): weigh-ins (measured date + time) · field weightKg
weighins → bodyidx (call): the latest before the session, up to 28 days old
objective → volume (cond): only when "check effort against the numbers" is on
registry → coef (data): each exercise’s contributions · field contributions
bodyidx → analyze (call): passed into buildProgression as the body-weight callback
fit → analyze (cond): only with usual days known, for a muscle still open and not held
analyze → choice (data): planRecovery, muscles, progression · field planRecovery
analyze → upcoming (data): usual training days · field usualDays
analyze → prescribe (data): muscles (today’s share) · field muscles
volume → prescribe (call): today’s volume recomputed (see audit C-9)
in_workout → choice (data): the live session: done sets, busy machines · field busyEquipment
in_settings → planner (data): priority muscles first (×1.3 / ×0.6) · field priorities
